rules: Never call the private backend directly or embed INTERNAL_API_TOKEN.
Treat only 2xx as success; decode non-2xx as RFC 9457 problem documents.
Persist every Set-Cookie in one CookieJar across auth and feature calls.
Send the latest csrfToken on state-changing requests that require CSRF.
After writes, re-read the authoritative GET named by afterSuccess.
Preserve null as a semantic value; never render the literal string null.
Use bigint-like monetary/count fields as strings when documented to avoid precision loss.
